evidence: DEFINING BEHAVIOUR IS GRADED: the brief's core promises each have a functional criterion in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml lines 34-158: hro_moves (w4), hro_two_people (w4, 409 stale move naming who + 15 s live update), hro_interview_places (w5.5), hro_bulk (w5), hro_undo (w5), hro_long_thread (w5.5), hro_messaging (w4), hro_unread_seen (w3.5), hro_candidate (w4.5). SERVER-BACKED: gate hro_gate_shared (gates/constraints/judge.toml line 64) adds a card via the UI, reloads, then reads it as the Observer in 'a new independent empty browser context' and states 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate'; every scored prompt restates this browser gate (functional/prompt.md line 15) and defines that 'A reload or a second tab of the same context is not independent'. Many criteria re-read order as Mei Lin or Aud in independent contexts (hro_moves, hro_bulk, hro_undo, hro_activity). Nothing requires same-origin, consistent with the public network. RESTART DURABILITY (Colderwater lesson 15): hro_intake_restart (functional/judge.toml line 31, w4.5) builds many distinct revisions (two new jobs, six cards in order, B moved to Screen, E re-ordered within Applied, F rejected with a suffixed reason, an internal note, a suffixed message, the unread total, J1 Activity lines, plus the seeded Platform Engineer order and Noor's quoted note), records them, calls restart_app once, signs in again in a fresh independent context (re-auth) and compares every one: 'After the restart everything recorded is unchanged (nothing lost, reordered or duplicated) and the starting data is not loaded again (the seeded jobs appear once).' 'A reload is not a restart; if restart_app reports an error or cannot be called, this criterion is 0.' The restart is real: test.sh lines 127-193 kill the app process group and relaunch node over the same DB_PATH as uid 65534; restart_mcp.py enforces single use. Lesson 16 (no double grading): the comparison is relative to the recorded pre-restart state, and functional/prompt.md line 21 lets setup blocked by a feature graded elsewhere be judged on the state the app produced. RELOAD / RE-AUTH OF BROWSER STATE: hro_drafts (line 130) covers per-conversation drafts across conversation switch, Board and reload; polish hro_pol_session_resume covers reply and note drafts across an ended session and re-sign-in, plus privacy from Mei on the same browser, matching hireops_rules.md section 6 'Drafts'. WEAK APPS: in-memory store fails the independent-context gate and the restart; localStorage-only store fails the gate; DB writes with reseed-on-boot fail 'seeded jobs appear once'; positions or read markers held in memory fail the recorded order and unread total after restart. CONFORMING ALTERNATIVES: other routes, labels, SSE/sockets/polling and any draft storage location are accepted (app_context 'The app may use any route layout and labels'). GOLDEN (scripted, not judge): group 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding; live updates resume' passed (results/workspace.json line 103; workspace.cjs 548-559: SIGTERM, relaunch, deepEqual of applications, activity, job count and per-person unread); db.js line 62 seeds only when the users table is empty. WHY risk=true: (1) NOT MEASURED, P2: no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'), so it is unproven that the judge completes hro_intake_restart and calls restart_app. The functional dimension runs mode='individual' with timeout=600 (functional/judge.toml lines 3-4; the template uses batched/9000), and hro_intake_restart is the heaviest single session: global gate, seeded reads, 2 job opens + 5 refused job attempts (one by replay), 6 UI additions, a Mei context read, 3 email attempts with field checks, move/re-order/reject/note/message, recording, restart, fresh-context re-sign-in and full comparison. If it exceeds 600 s the golden's only durability proof is NOT EXERCISED = 0. (2) P3, mainly rows 26/28/33: the only restart-durability credit (w4.5 binary) is conjoined with intake validation legs (blank title, places 0/51/2.5, Recruiter-as-manager, email-field refusal keeping typed values, case-insensitive duplicate), so a durable app with one validation slip gets no durability credit (REVIEW_POLICY: 'Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping'). These legs are public requirements (hireops_rules.md section 2), so no conforming app is failed. (3) P3 gap: the rejected-from stage, seen marks and undo eligibility are not re-read after the restart (F's rejection and reason are), so an app holding rejected_from only in memory would not be caught here.
suggested_fix: Measure a full configured judge run of hro_intake_restart on the golden (duration against the 600 s individual timeout, restart_app called once, every recorded fact compared); if tight, move the intake validation legs into their own criterion so the restart criterion only builds and compares state, and optionally add F's rejected-from stage to the recorded facts.
